name: goggles-curios
description: Robot Goggles in the Curios head slot are drawn on the head (issue #97). Needs the node's Curios jar in run-smoke/mods (not shipped by the runner). The player wears the goggles in the Curios slot, first bare-headed and then under an iron helmet, seen in both third-person views; compare against goggles-worn's third-front/third-back, which draw the same model from the vanilla helmet slot.

steps.label: floor, noon, bare head and hand, goggles into the Curios head slot
run: item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:air
item replace entity @p weapon.mainhand with minecraft:air

steps.name: curio-back
steps.look: third person from behind, nothing in the helmet slot: strap round the back of the head with the redstone chipset, same as goggles-worn third-back

steps.name: curio-front
steps.look: third person facing the player: the 3D goggles over the eyes (green lenses, iron frame), not a flat icon and not floating off the head

steps.label: an iron helmet on as well
run: item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:iron_helmet

steps.name: curio-helmet-front
steps.look: front view with an iron helmet: the goggles' frame and glass still show in front of the helmet's face opening

steps.label: sneak, so the head moves with the crouch

steps.name: curio-sneak
steps.look: crouching, front view: the goggles stay on the face, they don't stay at standing height

steps.label: clean up
run: item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:air
